section.title: Tasks
section.description: A project can track each production run and purchase with a task. Your community's automations make the task when Hoard tells Initiative a run started or a purchase was placed, and link it to the record. Hoard then keeps its section on the task up to date, and its button completes the run or receives the purchase.
